semantics.initializations: Retained proposals; InitFilter may pad invalid proposals to its quota
semantics.grasp_candidates: Saved after native grasp/pregrasp contact, collision, limit and QP filters
semantics.native_successes: Existing succ_grasp files/symlinks after unchanged six-axis native evaluation
semantics.native_evaluation: Gravity disabled; object mass 0.1 kg; +/-XYZ COM force 0.98 N; 2 s per axis; translation <0.05 m and rotation <15 deg
semantics.gravity_lift: Separate additional continuous-dynamics check; not applied to every native success unless listed in metrics
semantics.random_sequence_note: First ran d20, then expanded to all five table-top diameters with skip_done. Per-process RNG and already-present scenes influence sampling consumption; reproduce the recorded command order/configs for identical inputs.
